title: zapx: Code indexer crashes gitea on i386/x86 with "panic: unaligned 64-bit atomic operation"

labels.name: type/upstream
labels.description: This is an issue in one of Gitea's dependencies and should be reported there

body:
### Description

On an i386 system gitea 1.18.5 runs perfectly.
Version 1.19.0 crashes when indexing code.
#22279 #23274 https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/22481#issuecomment-1478032931

**zapx v15.3.9 fixes the problem**
https://github.com/blevesearch/zapx/commit/67addef2b53dd12a23282031e00ced4ac32befb1




### Gitea Version

1.19.0

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No

_No response_
